methodology.assetBytes: Filesystem byte sizes, excluding .git, node_modules, and this generated report.
methodology.startup: Static local src/href references in index.html. Browser runtime transfer values are reported separately.
methodology.cards: cards/*.html paired with same-name js/*.js plus statically discoverable local references.
methodology.records: Top-level array length; for objects, largest top-level array length or key count. This is structural, not semantic.
cautions: Dynamic paths assembled at runtime may not be attributed.
Remote CDN resources are not included in repository bytes.
Generated/authoritative labels are conservative heuristics unless declared in source.
